risk_assessment.risk_factor: Sustained bond yield spike (30Y near 2004 highs)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Shorten portfolio duration; favor floating-rate and short-duration credit; hedge with TIPS; monitor 10Y-30Y spread for curve steepening

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price shock above $103 with limited policy response
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight energy equities and tanker names; underweight rate-sensitive consumer discretionary; monitor Saudi pipeline fix and Trump UN speech

risk_assessment.risk_factor: AI valuation bubble / China competitive threat
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify AI exposure beyond Nvidia; monitor Alibaba chip performance; favor AI infrastructure (power, cooling, storage) over pure-play software; watch Anthropic IPO pricing

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Geopolitical escalation (Iran war legacy, media ban legal battles)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain 10-15% allocation to defense/aerospace (DRS, Hallador); monitor Trump-Xi follow-through; legal risk to media names
Avoid EM sovereign debt in stressed markets; favor hard-currency EM equities; monitor Waskita guarantee outcome as leading indicator

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market deterioration from rising rates
risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight homebuilders (KBH); favor rental REITs with fixed-rate debt; monitor 30Y mortgage rate vs. 5Y average

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight AI infrastructure and storage names benefiting from capex cycle
opportunities.rationale: SoftBank jumbo bond sale, Anthropic $2T IPO, Sandisk locking 2/3 of output signal sustained AI demand; storage and power are less crowded than GPU names

opportunities.recommendation: Add cybersecurity exposure on pullbacks; structural AI-driven threat tailwind intact
opportunities.rationale: Sector 'so hot' but AI expands attack surface; consolidation likely creates entry points

defensive_moves.recommendation: Shorten bond duration to 1-3 year Treasuries or TIPS; avoid 30Y exposure

defensive_moves.rationale: Waskita bond miss tests Indonesia guarantee; Philippines restructuring short-term bonds signals stress

market_outlook.short_term: Volatile. Bond selloff and oil >$103 create headwinds for equities, but AI-driven Nasdaq strength and Goldman/DB bullish S&P calls provide support. Expect 2-3% equity volatility as yields oscillate. European stocks lag. Watch for Fed reaction to 3.4% inflation + energy spike.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI capex cycle (Anthropic, SoftBank, Alibaba) supports tech leadership through 2027. Rising yields normalize valuations in rate-sensitive sectors. China trade truce and Vietnam upgrade broaden EM opportunity. Key risk: if oil sustains >$110, stagflation risk elevates.
